display_name: 先验恢复的估计信道与仿真真值对照
description: 固定地面去噪先验与盲后验初始化，对相同源 IQ 分别用估计信道和已知仿真信道执行相同一致性更新，诊断误差来源。

rows.method: fixed learned ground prior, common blind posterior; true versus predicted simulator action

rows.seed_notes: 4096 source fit IDs disjoint from 8192 existing prior IDs; fixed 384 RX8 probe
